source_typed_grammar_claims.source_primary_native_claim: Direct inherited Zhang et al 2018 IVSN VGG16 + top-down target similarity + 3 prior human visual-search experiments; added finite IOR+saliency+empirical saccade prior
Five proposed components source distinction feature extractor, bottom-up saliency, target template similarity, finite spatial IOR and saccade amplitude prior
Target similarity M_sim uses pretrained ImageNet VGG16 target layer31 as top-down convolution on visual search image layer30; no retraining on current eye movement samples
Free viewing saliency M_sal uses same pretrained conv features and uniform all-ones activation pooling, with no task target template
Empirical saccade size prior M_sac,t conditional on current fixation and condition-specific original observed saccade amplitude; dynamic map differs from fixed saliency
M_mem,t finite inhibition uses source fixation-age clipped exponential alpha=0.92 and floor beta=0.5, not infinite IOR or perfect forgetting
Each past fixation generates source Gaussian spatial memory trace whose sigma VS1=0.08 and other datasets=0.02; current memory takes maximum across these past traces
On a return fixation a new recent Gaussian trace overwrites lower decayed memory at earlier spatial location via max; this is source-defined history-dependent reuse, not an extra learned belief
Four normalized attention maps linear combination with w_mem=-0.93, w_sac=0.2346 and task-gated w_sim/w_sal; winner-take-all argmax selects next fixation
Visual search has w_sim=1,w_sal=0; free-view w_sim=0,w_sal=1, not both concurrently active original modes
M_sim and M_sal static for a given image; M_sac,t and M_mem,t update after each fixation; origin vs boundary temporal indices distinguishable
Visual search object recognition uses same pretrained VGG16 top classification features cosine distance with 1dva crop; source thresholds 0.5 for object arrays/Waldo and 0.3 natural
When recognition distance crosses per-task specified criterion visual search stops; free-viewing instead stops at corresponding dataset's average subject fixation count N_c

Input world includes static image I_s and optional target I_T, original measured gaze and dataset-specific empirical motor prior; task/eye tracking is experimental interface not internal brain coordinator
Source model has no motion temporal video integration, 3D egocentric memory or cooking policy; empirical human naturalistic behavior not predicted by implemented original model
Alpha/beta/sigma and relative two map weights set from original Visual Search 2 then held fixed for other five modeled datasets; not zero original calibration
Source model return-fixation rate over six modeled static cases spans 5.5±0.4% to 25.3±1%; observational 8 datasets remains distinct
Modeled short-offset return distributions and approximately 180-degree turning peak; model's VS2/VS3 prior-saccade trend differs from human source
Removing memory module increases simulated return proportion; infinite IOR by definition prevents returns; both not uniquely prove biology
Removing saliency/similarity map alters both fixation-map signal and chooser to stochastic sampling in source tests, not a one-variable unchanged-chooser intervention
Ablating saccade prior has less effect on return count than saccade-size distribution/offset; source metrics show mixed/no worsening for some properties
Source null draws random movements from empirical saccade distribution and same stopping rule, so memoryless does not mean uniform pixel sampling or no motor prior
Original source no learning in present model and no fixation duration, saccade duration or momentum; cannot add these imagined cognitive states in reconstruction
Original model assumes constant visual acuity across field and limited recognition, context integrated across multiple saccades absent, quantitative match not uniformly good
Proposed multi-mechanism sufficiency is source proof of principle, not unique neural localization/necessity or universal species and task transfer

Separate original new 20-worker two-choice psychophysics target-feature similarity used observations, with 412 object-array and 1,041 natural patch pairs; not computational model trained on these pairs
Source 2018 IVSN inherited same target feature selection and historical experiments; only composite finite IOR and free-view saliency is new paper central scope; direct genealogy must remain visible
